cells: Expenses charged on Consolidated Fund of India

blocks.content: The expenses, including the salaries, allowances and pensions of the chairman and members of the UPSC are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India.

rows: Ineligible for any further employment under GOI or any State
Eligible only as Chairman of UPSC or Chairman of an SPSC
Not eligible for a second term
Not eligible for a second term as member

items: The Chairman of UPSC is completely ineligible for any further employment under the central or state government post-retirement.
A member of UPSC can become the Chairman of UPSC or a State Public Service Commission (SPSC), but cannot be re-appointed as a member.
Removal on the grounds of misbehaviour requires an inquiry by the Supreme Court, whose advice is binding on the President.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Security of Tenure: The Chairman and members of UPSC can be removed from office by the President only in the manner and on the grounds specified in the Constitution.
Fixed Conditions of Service: The conditions of service of the chairman or members cannot be varied to their disadvantage after their appointment.
Non-Votable Expenses: The salaries, allowances, and pensions of the chairman and members are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India and are not subject to parliamentary vote.
Bar on Re-appointment: Neither the chairman nor members are eligible for re-appointment to the same office for a second term.
Bar on Further Employment: The Chairman of UPSC is strictly ineligible for any further employment under the Government of India or any state government.
